source.description: Photogrammetric 3D buildings (roofs at least 0.5 m accuracy, walls derived from roofs).

coordinateTransform.description: ČÚZK table_-y-x_3_v1710 projected grid, then Inverse of Modified Krovak East North (Greenwich) + S-JTSK/05 to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)

method.assignment: Roof and detail faces belong to the current OSM footprint containing their plan centroid (or the nearest within roofAssignmentMeters for overhangs); walls on a footprint outline are rendered from the OSM outline with the measured top profile.

encoding.positions: Int32 little-endian centimetres (world x, y = altitude - baselineAltitude, z), delta coded from the previous vertex of the same building, base64
encoding.indices: Uint16 little-endian, local to each building's vertexStart, base64
encoding.walls: Per ring, per OSM edge (points[i] to points[i + 1]): flattened [t, y] pairs, y in world metres; empty when the edge has no measured roof

orthophoto.title: IPR Praha, Ortofotomapa Prahy – poslední snímkování (10 cm), 8. 6. 2024, a infračervená ortofotomapa
orthophoto.roofColour: Median sRGB of footprint pixels shrunk by 1 m, without vegetation (NDVI >= 0.2) and shadow (roofColorMeasured); roofColor corrects aerial haze with HLS saturation x1.6 (max 0.65) and lightness x0.85.
